title: SonicWorld: Source-Centric Latent Dynamics for Spatial Audio Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17131v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dynamic spatial audio reasoning requires a model to associate changing acoustic observations with the correct source and recover its spatial state at a queried time or interval, a challenge intensified by overlapping speech and source motion. To study this problem, we introduce Sonic-Bench, comprising 2.8K first-order Ambisonics clips and 28.8K target-specific question-answer pairs across 480 simulated indoor scenes. The benchmark covers localization, distance estimation, and motion reasoning in single- and dual-source settings. We further propose SonicWorld, which integrates physical, learned acoustic, and semantic features into persistent source states through learned transitions and recurrent updates, and projects them into an Omni LLM for spatial reasoning. Compared with Spatial-Omni on the Sonic-Bench test split, SonicWorld improves direction accuracy from 31.98% to 34.69% and reduces azimuth error from 57.22{\deg} to 48.01{\deg}.

translated_title: SonicWorld：面向空间音频推理的以声源为中心的潜在动态方法
translated_abstract: 动态空间音频推理要求模型将不断变化的声学观测与正确的声源关联起来，并在被查询的时刻或时间区间内恢复该声源的空间状态，而语音重叠和声源运动进一步加剧了这一挑战。为了研究该问题，我们提出了Sonic-Bench基准，其中包含480个模拟室内场景下的2.8K条一阶Ambisonics音频片段和28.8K条针对特定目标的问答对。该基准覆盖单源和双源设置下的定位、距离估计和运动推理任务。我们进一步提出SonicWorld模型，通过可学习的状态转移和循环更新，将物理特征、学习到的声学特征以及语义特征整合为持久化的声源状态，并将其投影到Omni大语言模型中以实现空间推理。在Sonic-Bench测试集上，与Spatial-Omni相比，SonicWorld将方向准确率从31.98%提升至34.69%，并将方位角误差从57.22°降低至48.01°。
tldr: 该论文提出了动态空间音频推理基准Sonic-Bench及模型SonicWorld，通过将物理、声学与语义特征整合为持久化声源状态并投影到Omni大语言模型，显著提升了方向准确率并降低了方位角误差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Sonic-Bench, a dynamic spatial audio reasoning benchmark, and SonicWorld, a model that integrates physical, learned acoustic, and semantic features into persistent source states projected into an Omni LLM, improving direction accuracy and reducing azimuth error over Spatial-Omni.
